meta.title: Run Log
meta.systemIntro: Run tiantan_build_001 resolves workspace/Craft_Utopia/tiantan.png and replays layered chats: User/System Bot, System Bot/PM, PM/Designer, PM/Foremans, and five Foreman-A through Foreman-E worker-pool rooms covering 100 workers.

stages.label: 01 Request
stages.system: System Bot opens workspace/Craft_Utopia/runs/tiantan_build_001, pins the input image, and creates the Project Manager channel.

stages.label: 02 PM Setup
stages.system: Project Manager accepts the run, requests Designer blueprint output, and prepares role-based planning constraints.

stages.label: 03 Design
stages.system: Designer runs reconstruction and exports placements.jsonl, stage_preview.schem, cues.json, and uncertainty notes.

stages.label: 04 Foremen
stages.system: Project Manager coordinates Foreman-A through Foreman-E and assigns one 20-worker pool to each Foreman.

stages.label: 05 Build Pools
stages.system: Foreman-A through Foreman-E worker-pool rooms show aggregate progress, checkpoint events, and only important worker exceptions.

stages.label: 06 Return
stages.system: Project Manager verifies merged_state.json against placements.jsonl and returns the packaged final artifacts through System Bot.
